Switchgear | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist 
 11,which must be performed every 5 years bases as indicated by Y5 in the above 
 title Block
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz Elbagoury, tested 
 by eng. Essam EL Sayed EL Razzaz, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng 
 Tawfek EL Albasery, accepted by electrical manager eng Mohamed El-lawindy 
 approved by eng Awad Fathy Head sector of Talkha PS, approved by eng. Tawfik 
 El Sayed Tawfik, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman admin. & 
 financial inspection & quality control's general director and supervisor of 
 EDEPCo inspection & quality control's head sector
Safety Precautions
A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
All Breakers are disconnected and out of 
 service.
Incoming Breaker and interconnection Breaker 
 are disconnected and out of service.
Bus-bar isolation and proper earthing is 
 required.
Tools and Equipment
DC Resistance measuring instrument.
Complete tool set, grease.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Brushes, blower, megger device (Metreso 5000) and digital 
 voltmeter.
Work to be carried out
Clean breaker from any dust.
Check screw connections for tightness.
Grease the 
 Breaker operating mechanism.
Clean arcing contacts by means smooth file.
Close the breaker 
 mechanically.
Open the breaker mechanically.
Check the charging and discharging Breaker 
 manually.
Check the connection of earthing system.
Check cable sockets of Breaker .
Check 
 pushbuttons, signal lamps, fuses and auxiliary relays .
Check control voltage value.
Check charging and discharging breaker 
 electrically.
Check operation of Breaker from local in test 
 position.
Check operation of Breaker from Remote in test 
 position.
Check the interlocks for operation of Breaker .
Check interconnection terminals.
Check all protection devices by protection 
 group.
Check coupling of bus bar to tighten bolts of 
 the connection on branches of cable.
Measure insulation resistance of main bus-bar 
 by using mugger device 500V d.c (M 
 Ω) table 1
Measure D.C Resistance of main bus-bar (Ω 
 ) table 2.
